MASTER SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Master Services Agreement is entered into on 15 January 2026 between Narmada Retail Private Limited, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 with its registered office at Plot 7, Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai 400051 ("Client") and Tungabhadra Software Solutions Private Limited, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 with its registered office at 4th Floor, HITEC City, Hyderabad 500081 ("Service Provider").

RECITALS

A. The Client operates a chain of retail stores across India.
B. The Service Provider is in the business of developing and maintaining software.
C. The Client wishes to engage the Service Provider on the terms of this Agreement.

1 Scope of Services

1.1 The Service Provider shall provide the services described in each statement of work signed by both parties ("Services").

1.2 In the event of a conflict between this Agreement and a statement of work, this Agreement shall prevail unless the statement of work expressly states otherwise.

2 Fees and Payment

2.1 The Client shall pay the fees set out in Schedule A. The total fees under the first statement of work are INR 48,00,000 (Rupees Forty-Eight Lakh only), exclusive of taxes.

2.2 The Service Provider shall raise invoices monthly in arrears. The Client shall pay each undisputed invoice within 90 days of receipt.

2.3 All fees are exclusive of Goods and Services Tax, which shall be charged at the applicable rate. The Client may deduct tax at source as required under the Income-tax Act, 1961 and shall furnish TDS certificates within the statutory period.

2.4 Interest on overdue amounts shall accrue at 18% per annum.

3 Term

This Agreement commences on the date first written above and continues for an initial term of 3 years. It shall renew automatically for successive periods of 1 year unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least 120 days before the end of the then-current term.

4 Intellectual Property

4.1 All intellectual property rights in the deliverables shall vest in the Service Provider. The Client is granted a non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use the deliverables for its internal business purposes.

4.2 Each party retains all rights in its pre-existing materials.

5 Data Protection

5.1 The Service Provider shall process personal data only on the documented instructions of the Client and in compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

5.2 The Service Provider shall implement reasonable security safeguards to prevent a personal data breach and shall notify the Client of any breach without undue delay.

6 Limitation of Liability

6.1 The total liability of the Service Provider under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid by the Client in the 3 months preceding the claim.

6.2 Neither party shall be liable for any indirect or consequential loss.

6.3 The Client shall indemnify the Service Provider against all claims, losses and expenses arising out of the Client's use of the deliverables, without limit.

7 Termination

7.1 The Service Provider may terminate this Agreement for convenience by giving 30 days written notice.

7.2 The Client may terminate this Agreement only for material breach by the Service Provider that remains uncured for 90 days after written notice.

8 Non-Solicitation and Non-Compete

8.1 During the term and for 12 months thereafter, neither party shall solicit the employees of the other.

8.2 For a period of 2 years after termination, the Client shall not engage any other vendor to provide services similar to the Services.

9 Governing Law and Jurisdiction

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of India. The courts at Hyderabad shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of this Agreement.

10 Notices

Any notice under this Agreement shall be in writing and delivered by registered post or email to the addresses set out above.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties have signed this Agreement through their authorised signatories.

Signed for and on behalf of Narmada Retail Private Limited
Name: Meera Deshpande
Title: Chief Operating Officer

Signed for and on behalf of Tungabhadra Software Solutions Private Limited
Name: Rohit Reddy
Title: Managing Director

SCHEDULE A - FEES

1. Monthly retainer: INR 4,00,000.
2. Additional development: INR 2,500 per person-hour.
3. Travel outside Hyderabad shall be reimbursed at actuals.

SCHEDULE B - SERVICE LEVELS

1. Critical incidents shall be acknowledged within 1 hour.
2. Monthly uptime of the hosted application shall be at least 99.5%.
